auth_tokens_rw.name: auth_tokens_rw
auth_tokens_rw.using: (coalesce(current_setting('app.org_id', true), '') = '' and coalesce(current_setting('app.user_id', true), '') = '') OR user_id = current_setting('app.user_id', true)
auth_tokens_rw.withCheck: (coalesce(current_setting('app.org_id', true), '') = '' and coalesce(current_setting('app.user_id', true), '') = '') OR user_id = current_setting('app.user_id', true)

join_requests_read.name: join_requests_read
join_requests_read.using: org_id = current_setting('app.org_id', true) OR user_id = current_setting('app.user_id', true) OR (coalesce(current_setting('app.org_id', true), '') = '' and coalesce(current_setting('app.user_id', true), '') = '')

join_requests_insert.name: join_requests_insert
join_requests_insert.withCheck: (coalesce(current_setting('app.org_id', true), '') = '' and coalesce(current_setting('app.user_id', true), '') = '') OR user_id = current_setting('app.user_id', true)

memberships_rls.name: memberships_rls
memberships_rls.using: org_id = current_setting('app.org_id', true) OR (coalesce(current_setting('app.org_id', true), '') = '' AND user_id = current_setting('app.user_id', true))

notifications_rls.name: notifications_rls
notifications_rls.using: org_id = current_setting('app.org_id', true) AND user_id = current_setting('app.user_id', true)

organizations_read.name: organizations_read
organizations_read.using: id = current_setting('app.org_id', true) OR id IN (select org_id from memberships where user_id = current_setting('app.user_id', true)) OR (coalesce(current_setting('app.org_id', true), '') = '' and coalesce(current_setting('app.user_id', true), '') = '')

sessions_rw.name: sessions_rw
sessions_rw.using: (coalesce(current_setting('app.org_id', true), '') = '' and coalesce(current_setting('app.user_id', true), '') = '') OR user_id = current_setting('app.user_id', true)
sessions_rw.withCheck: (coalesce(current_setting('app.org_id', true), '') = '' and coalesce(current_setting('app.user_id', true), '') = '') OR user_id = current_setting('app.user_id', true)

users_read.name: users_read
users_read.using: id = current_setting('app.user_id', true) OR id IN (select user_id from memberships where org_id = current_setting('app.org_id', true)) OR id IN (select user_id from join_requests where org_id = current_setting('app.org_id', true) and status = 'PENDING') OR (coalesce(current_setting('app.org_id', true), '') = '' and coalesce(current_setting('app.user_id', true), '') = '')

skill_versions_read.name: skill_versions_read
skill_versions_read.using: org_id = current_setting('app.org_id', true) OR skill_id IN (select id from skills where is_template = true)

skills_read.name: skills_read
skills_read.using: org_id = current_setting('app.org_id', true) OR is_template = true
